name: Machine Reverse-Grip T-Bar Row
steps: Lie chest-down on a T-bar row machine with your feet braced firmly on the footplates and grasp the handles using an underhand palms-up grip.
Lift the lever slightly off the catch so your arms hang straight with a slight stretch across your upper back.
Pull the handles back toward your lower chest by driving your elbows close to your ribs and squeezing your lats.
Extend your arms to lower the lever slowly, then guide it back onto the catch when finished.
tips: Keep your chest firmly in contact with the pad rather than lifting your torso to yank the weight.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders toward your ears as you row.
